corrections.reason: The Ge'ez noun for 'tail' is ዘነብ (6th order ብ), which is clearly visible in the print with the left-bottom notch of ብ.
The printed text clearly shows ወበዝ ('And by this / herewith one woe is past'), where the middle character በ was omitted in Stage 1.

corrections.reason: The commentary is glossing the Ge'ez preposition እምነ from line 1 ('እምነ ፡ በ ፡ ማለት ፡ ነው'), and the 1st-order ነ (without top-left hook of ን) is clearly printed.
